placements.why: The directives name an organizational practice — controlling what knowledge is retained or purged — that no existing strata category covers. This is an organizational-strategy tier category, not a single narrative theme.
placements.title: Authority over retained and purged knowledge
placements.frame: What practices and directives govern which knowledge an organization holds, removes, or forgets?

placements.title: Commanded forgetting as organizational practice
placements.frame: How does an imperative erasure directive perform authority over what knowledge the organization may retain?
placements.why: Both segments deploy imperative erasure formulas commanding wholesale removal of specific named knowledge. The theme — authority exercised through directed forgetting — is a directional statement true beyond the words it describes, a subject future envelopes may feed.
